title: Metoyer's method books
summary: Ernie describes Metoyer's patient teaching and the books he used: a French method first, then the Arban method.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Oh, interrupted. About those lessons, I was interested since Mr. Matriya is gone. We did talk to his widow and daughter. Yeah. And they told us quite a bit about him. But I wondered in his teaching, did he use a certain method? What method do you remember?
Well, I'll tell you one thing he was. Yes, he was very determined in teaching here. And he had very much patience. He would give you a lesson and...
Remember any method book that he used?

Well, yeah, he bought, you know, the first book he bought me was a French Pocharon book. I don't know him. No, he got that, true of his, Vorice, which he used to play first trumpet at the Offsen Theatre, I believe his brother would say that. Yeah, true of his brother. Well, see, they were very good friends. He got the book for him. And after I finished that book, then he got me one of these Auburn Methods. Oh, yeah. I remember that. That's the book he brought me through, the Auburn Method. And then when I went out and started playing... Well, to get on...
